assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are suggestive of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events
The service addresses the specific clinical need for extended monitoring
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I49.9
